record.question: The Union government plans to initiate safe city plan for women in....cities.
record.explanation: Answer A: 8. The 2017 Safe City pilot plan covered eight cities. The Home Ministry’s 20 December 2017 parliamentary reply names Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad and Lucknow. Historical/source note: The initial eight-city pilot plan, not every later Safe City programme. Reference: https://www.mha.gov.in/MHA1/Par2017/pdfs/par2017-pdfs/rs-20122017/540.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
